verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules, such as on-publish hooks, are a fair question for a media relay or CDN server. However, the evidence documents no user-definable rules or event-to-action triggers. Built-in automatic behaviors (broadcast discovery and gossip, encoding only when watched) are fixed protocol features, not user-defined rules. SageOx's archiver and transcription consumers are a user-built workaround made of separate subscribers, which earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
